about.title: SILPONIX
about.text: Silponix is a Czech company based in Otrokovice, specialising in motorsport and Honda vehicle modifications. We bring our experience from rally, rallycross and circuit racing into every product and service.
about.story_text: Silponix is a Czech company based in Otrokovice, founded by the Mezihorak brothers — active competitors in rally, rallycross and hillclimb events. We channel our motorsport experience into every product and service. Since 2009, we have been building race cars, tuning engines and manufacturing polyurethane bushings for Honda and other makes. We are a certified Hondata dealer for the Czech Republic.
about.team_text: We're a crew of motorsport enthusiasts. The Mezihorak brothers and a team of skilled mechanics, engineers and racers. Each of us brings hands-on track experience straight into the workshop.
about.partners_subtitle: We work with leading companies in motorsport.
about.page_subtitle: A Czech company based in Otrokovice, specialising in motorsport and Honda modifications.
